content_sections.heading: About DAVV
content_sections.text: Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya is based in Indore, and its School of Computer Science & IT is at Takshashila Campus, Khandwa Road. The school's letterhead states that it is accredited Grade 'A+' by NAAC. Its programmes include Ph.D, M.Tech, PGDCA, M.Sc. (CS/IT), MBA (CM), MCA and the five-year MCA (Integrated).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DAVV Visiting Faculty Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the SCSIT Visiting Faculty Google form , or submit a detailed resume to Dr. Jyoti Ratnawat in the office. If you submit a hard copy, list these details in chronological order: name, category, qualification, experience, present working organization, research publications, projects undertaken, project guidance, achievements and awards. Mention the course name and your preferred timing in the subject line of the application. Attach the documents listed below. Complete your application by 5 PM on the last date. Documents to attach: PG Marksheet NET/SLET Certificate Industry Experience PhD Certificate Experience Certificate Office address: School of Computer Science & IT, Takshashila Campus, Khandwa Road, Indore (MP) 452001, India. Phone: 0731-2470041, 42, 43, Ext. 530.

faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for the DAVV Visiting Faculty post?
faq.answer: Interested candidates from industry or academia can apply. Their qualification and experience will be considered as per AICTE/UGC norms.

faq.question: Q2. What time does the application window close?
faq.answer: Applications close at 5 PM on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Can I apply without using the Google form?
faq.answer: Yes. You can submit a detailed resume to Dr. Jyoti Ratnawat in the office.

faq.question: Q4. What should I write in the subject line?
faq.answer: Write the course name and your preferred timing.

faq.question: Q5. When will classes be held?
faq.answer: Classes will be held between 9 AM and 6 PM, although M.Tech (Executive) Computer Science and PhD Course Work classes may be held on weekends.

faq.question: Q6. Can I teach both theory and practical courses?
faq.answer: Yes. SCSIT requires Visiting Faculty for theory and/or practical courses.

faq.question: Q7. Are non-computer science subjects included?
faq.answer: Yes. The allied list includes Communication Skills, Environmental Science, Mathematics, and English Language and Composition.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I send questions about this recruitment?
faq.answer: Email [email protected]. The 16 November 2026 deadline also applies to mailing queries.
